findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂による魔術診断
findings.governingReading: Rin performs a magecraft diagnosis.
findings.explanation: The technical object of the analysis disappears.

findings.evidenceJa: お香を焚いて
findings.governingReading: Rin burns incense as part of the diagnostic procedure.
findings.explanation: The mass noun is given a malformed singular article.

findings.evidenceJa: 該当なし
findings.governingReading: The tests produce no applicable elemental classification.
findings.explanation: The English sounds absolute and ontological rather than reporting no match within the classification.

findings.evidenceJa: 魔術回路判断
findings.governingReading: Rin abandons the assessment of Shirou Emiya’s Magic Circuits.
findings.explanation: The system is again singularized.

findings.evidenceJa: そこから先の聖別
findings.governingReading: Rin says further discrimination or classification lies outside her specialty.
findings.explanation: “Consecration” invents a religious rite and makes the diagnostic explanation incoherent.

findings.evidenceJa: 使える魔術
findings.governingReading: Rin will infer his classification from the magecraft he can perform.
findings.explanation: Technical magecraft is again generalized to magic.

findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂が用意した水粘土
findings.governingReading: Rin supplies water-based modeling clay for the exercise.
findings.explanation: The material specification disappears.

findings.highlight: returns to its original form no matter what happens to it
findings.evidenceJa: いくら手を加えても元の固まりに戻る
findings.governingReading: The ether lump returns to its original mass however much one deliberately alters it.
findings.explanation: Deliberate intervention becomes anything happening to it, and the concrete original lump becomes abstract form.

findings.highlight: even if you bundle it with strong magical energy
findings.evidenceJa: 強い魔力でくくっても
findings.governingReading: Even binding or fixing the material with very strong magical energy cannot prevent restoration.
findings.explanation: “Bundle it” is dictionary-near but fails to express magical constraint.

findings.highlight: meat that never goes away, no matter how much of it you eat
findings.evidenceJa: 中国に伝わる幾ら食べても減らない肉、だったっけか
findings.governingReading: Shirou tentatively recalls shiniku as inexhaustible meat handed down in Chinese tradition.
findings.explanation: The cultural provenance and his uncertain recollection both disappear.

findings.evidenceJa: その呪文は自己流なのか
findings.governingReading: Rin asks whether that incantation is Shirou’s own improvised style.
findings.explanation: A question about one chant becomes a judgment that his entire magical education is self-directed.

findings.evidenceJa: [ruby text=きりつぐ char=2]師匠はどんな教え方をしていたのか
findings.governingReading: The written text identifies his master while the ruby names Kiritsugu.
findings.explanation: The personal name survives but the master-student role performed by the base text disappears.

findings.highlight: I don’t know what she’s angry about
findings.evidenceJa: 何が気に食わないのか
findings.governingReading: Shirou wonders what she finds objectionable or displeasing.
findings.explanation: The English certifies the stronger emotion of anger.

findings.highlight: I do regret that you’re an amateur
findings.evidenceJa: 後悔はしてるけど……未熟って言っても
findings.governingReading: Rin admits regretting the alliance, then qualifies Shirou’s immaturity by locating the problem in how he was taught.
findings.explanation: The object of regret becomes his amateur status, collapsing her pivot away from inherent incompetence.

findings.evidenceJa: 衛宮くんの工房
findings.governingReading: Rin asks about projected objects remaining in Shirou’s magus workshop.
findings.explanation: The mundane building replaces its magical function.

findings.highlight: I use projection as a breather in between strengthening magic
findings.evidenceJa: “強化”の息抜き、魔術が上手くいかない時の試しで行う“投影”
findings.governingReading: Shirou uses Projection both as a diversion from Reinforcement and as an experiment when magecraft is going badly.
findings.explanation: The second and diagnostically relevant circumstance disappears.

findings.highlight: She told me to make a vase
findings.evidenceJa: お題は土瓶
findings.governingReading: Rin assigns an earthenware teapot as the Projection target.
findings.explanation: The requested object changes to a vase.

findings.evidenceJa: もう夕暮れ時になっていた
findings.governingReading: It has already become dusk.
findings.explanation: The concrete time and completed onset of evening become vague lateness.

findings.highlight: Tohsaka is helping me as a fellow magus
findings.evidenceJa: 戦友として、魔術師としての俺を面倒みてくれている
findings.governingReading: Rin cares for him as a comrade-in-arms and looks after his development as a magus.
findings.explanation: Two asymmetric relationships collapse into the false suggestion that Shirou and Rin are simply peer magi.

findings.evidenceJa: 家に残してきた桜も心配だ
findings.governingReading: Shirou also worries about Sakura whom he left behind at home.
findings.explanation: Her location and his responsibility for leaving her there disappear.
